entities.summary: Liz Carmouche is an American mixed martial arts fighter currently competing in the women’s Flyweight division of the Professional Fighters League (PFL), where she was the 2025 PFL Women’s Flyweight Tournament Champion. As of January 27, 2026, she is #2 in the PFL women's flyweight rankings. She formerly competed in Bellator MMA, where she was the last Bellator Women's Flyweight World Champion. Carmouche also competed for the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) in the Women's Flyweight and Women's Bantamweight divisions, being a championship challenger for both divisions.
